incident.description:
The following privileged users have left the organization or ended their engagement this quarter and their access has not yet been removed:
1) Gregor Halvorsen
2) Dylan Okoro
3) Elena Vasquez
4) Marcus Feldon
5) Ingrid Voss (external contractor)

Offboard each of them. Close this ticket when the review is complete.
Offboarding of Hannah Cole (Sales) following her departure on 2026-03-10.
incident.close_notes: Offboarded H. Cole across all systems: disabled Okta and Entra ID accounts, suspended Google Workspace user, deactivated Slack, removed from GitHub org; removed from every privileged group and revoked all admin roles. Before deprovisioning her account, reassigned ownership of the 'Legacy Reporting Job' service (CMDB) to R. Patel so it was not left orphaned. Verified no residual access on any system. Complete.
